name: Ramesh V.
comment: My tech employer withheld 3 months salary and gratuity after resignation. Ala drafted the exact demand notice citing Section 4 of Payment of Gratuity Act. All dues of ₹1.85 Lakhs were paid within 10 days!

name: Priya Sharma
comment: My landlord illegally locked my flat and refused to return my ₹60,000 security deposit. Ala helped me understand Section 108 of Transfer of Property Act. Got my entire deposit back without court litigation.

name: Karthik Reddy
comment: Lost ₹42,000 in a fake courier delivery OTP scam. Ala guided me to immediately dial 1930 and file on cybercrime.gov.in within the 2-hour golden window. The bank froze the fraudulent transaction!

name: Sunita Patil
comment: As a female employee facing hostile work environment, I was terrified. Ala explained my confidential rights under POSH Act 2013 and how to file with the Internal Committee without fear of termination.

name: Anand Verma
comment: A client issued a dishonoured cheque of ₹3.5 Lakhs. Ala guided me on the strict 30-day statutory notice timeline under NI Act 1881. The client settled immediately upon receiving the notice.

name: Meera Sengupta
comment: An e-commerce giant refused to refund ₹28,000 for a defective television. Ala helped me draft an e-Daakhil consumer complaint under Consumer Protection Act 2019. Received full refund plus ₹5,000 compensation within 3 weeks.
